crossRefs.note: Saul’s uncle said, “Please tell me what Samuel said to you.”

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul’s uncle said, “Please tell me what Samuel said to you.”
translations.bsb: “Tell me,” Saul’s uncle asked, “what did Samuel say to you?”
translations.kjv: And Saul's uncle said, Tell me, I pray thee, what Samuel said unto you.
translations.asv: And Saul's uncle said, Tell me, I pray thee, what Samuel said unto you.
